title: Ayurveda
subtitle: Foundations for daily balance
summary: Ayurveda frames wellness as balance among three bio-energies (doshas) and the five elements. Practical routines align your body with seasonal and daily rhythms.

sections.title: Tridosha framework
sections.body: Vata (ether/air), Pitta (fire/water), and Kapha (earth/water) describe how energy moves through body and mind. Balance is restored by choosing foods, routines, and practices that counter the current imbalance.

sections.title: Prakriti vs. Vikriti
sections.body: Prakriti is your baseline constitution; Vikriti is the current state shaped by stress, climate, and lifestyle. Ayurveda aims to align the present state back to baseline through gentle shifts.
bullets: Notice seasonal changes in appetite, mood, and digestion

sections.title: Seasonal rhythm (Ritucharya)
sections.body: Each season emphasizes different qualities. Matching food, movement, and rest to those shifts keeps the system steady.
bullets: Spring: reduce heaviness, invite light movement
Summer: cool the system, hydrate, slow down
Autumn: ground and warm, reduce dryness

sections.title: Daily rhythm (Dinacharya)
sections.body: Small daily rituals like warm water on waking, light dinners, and early sleep create steady energy and digestion.
bullets: Sleep before the late-night energy spike
